messages:
maria (Security PM): Quick sync — SOC2 launch checklist. Need a firm decision on retention windows + HSM onboarding timeline. Meeting with Legal + Enterprise next Tue. Who can own scope?
aj (Eng-Infra): I can own HSM integration but need clarity on key rotation policy and KMS fallback.
praveen (Sales ENG): Legal is pushing per-tenant export capability for e-discovery — this is blocking two enterprise deals.
taylor (Finance): Ops prefers 90d default retention. 365d will spike our storage spend.
elaine (SRE): Cold-tier after 90d sounds fine from infra perspective. Cold archive needs to be encrypted and retrievable within SLA.
maria (Security PM): Proposal: default 90d hot, 365d cold archive encrypted with HSM-wrapped keys; delete after 3 years for retention category B. Need signoff from Privacy + Sales.
aj (Eng-Infra): HSM onboarding blockers: vendor contract lead time + import workflows. If we defer HSM to M2, can we ship KMS-only with documented compensating controls?
praveen (Sales ENG): Enterprise customers will require HSM in contract language. Sales can't promise without a clear M2 timeline.
taylor (Finance): Launch criteria suggestion: 1) automated evidence collection for retention proofs, 2) KMS + ACLs documented, 3) HSM integration OR documented compensating control, 4) e2e export test harness.
maria (Security PM): Also add audit-log retention behavior to criteria — Legal suggested 1 year accessible, 7 years archived.
elaine (SRE): Audit logs must be append-only and signed. We can leverage the signing service in vault for rotation events.
aj (Eng-Infra): Tech note / playbook snippet for exports (require mTLS):
```
POST /admin/export
Authorization: Bearer <service-token>
X-Export-Request: tenant=12345
```
We should require mTLS + scoped service tokens.
praveen (Sales ENG): Sales is asking for SLA language: 'HSM onboarding ETA: 60-90 days after contract signature'. Can we commit to 90 days?
maria (Security PM): Don't promise 60. Commit to 90 and aim for 60. Action items: aj -> HSM vendor eval by 2026-03-15; taylor -> cost model for 365 cold tier by 2026-03-12; elaine -> export signing PoC by 2026-03-08; praveen -> capture customer legal asks + sample contract language.
aj (Eng-Infra): :thumbsup: Starting vendor eval today. Please DM if you have preferred vendors.
taylor (Finance): I'll run cost sims and add numbers to the roadmap doc.
praveen (Sales ENG): FYI Sales will accept 90 days if we provide pen test + SOC2 timeline in pre-sign materials.
maria (Security PM): Final: add items to roadmap M2 with launch-criteria checklist. We'll present at PM review on 2026-03-20. Thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: Document created: soc2-retention-archival-proposal.md (linked in #eng-security)
